memory_lessons.applicability: Use as a schedule comparison point, not as a per-configuration performance prediction.
memory_lessons.claim: The measured dynamic-64 candidate was valid at 0.46135 s aggregate, compared with 0.46414 s for cyclic static scanlines and 0.73468 s for contiguous static scanlines. These aggregate values do not show which schedule wins in each official configuration.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Measure dynamic-16 against dynamic-64 and retain per-configuration repeated timings.

proposal.hypothesis: Dynamic 16-pixel chunks may improve load balance over the measured dynamic-64 schedule when per-pixel hit and ambient-occlusion work varies, especially at high thread counts, but the extra scheduling overhead may offset that benefit. A direct serial path should avoid OpenMP team overhead at one thread. This tests chunk granularity against the valid dynamic-64 candidate; observed aggregate timings do not establish a per-configuration winner.

retained: Replace ambient-worker drand48 calls with per-pixel SplitMix64 streams seeded from a serial render-seed draw and linear pixel index.
Use OpenMP dynamic scheduling over flattened pixels with chunk size 16 and num_threads capped at the requested thread count; use a direct serial loop for one thread.
Preserve the primary-ray and ambient-ray counts, ray calculations, and one-pixel-per-worker output ownership.
